performance.verdict: ROAS surge is real but purchase clustering masks thin daily volume.

findings.text: 28-day ROAS is 3.29x on $1,490.50 spend; 7d ROAS jumped 157.9% but only 8 purchase days exist in 28 — revenue is event-driven, not steady.
Live-Cooking Event shoot (due 2026-08-14) shows no completed event — 12 days overdue; no real-footage creative entering the funnel from this deliverable.
3-day signal (Aug 23–25): 0 purchases, $0 revenue vs prior 3 days (Aug 20–22): 2 purchases, $228.98 — short-window stall after the 157.9% ROAS week.
GBP actions hit 0 on Aug 24 and Aug 25 (prior 45-day average ~17/day) — two consecutive zero days is anomalous, possible listing or data feed issue.
IG reach fell from a 45-day high of 1,105 (Aug 25) but trended down from 996 (Aug 3) to 469 (Aug 22) before recovering — creative pool showing fatigue mid-cycle.

suggestions.text: Hold spend flat; monitor purchases Aug 26–28 to confirm 3-day stall is noise, not reversal of 157.9% ROAS week.
suggestions.monday_update: The last 3 days (Aug 23–25) produced 0 purchases and $0 revenue after a week where ROAS jumped 157.9% and purchases were up 33.33%. Hold daily spend near the current $53/day run-rate and do not scale until at least 2 purchases appear in any rolling 3-day window. Re-check on 2026-08-29; if still zero, escalate to budget-shift or creative-refresh review.

suggestions.text: Escalate Live-Cooking Shoot delivery to Video team — 12 days overdue, blocking fresh creative needed to address IG fatigue.
suggestions.monday_update: The Live-Cooking Event shoot was due 2026-08-14 and has no completed event logged — it is 12 days overdue. IG reach declined from a 45-day peak of 996 (Aug 3) to 469 (Aug 22) before a partial recovery, signalling creative fatigue that real-footage assets would address. Nacer to get a hard delivery date from the Video team by 2026-08-28; if no date is confirmed, flag to Sohib for client communication. Success check: shoot assets in Drive by that confirmed date.

suggestions.text: Verify GBP listing health — 2 consecutive zero-action days (Aug 24–25) vs 45-day average of ~17 actions/day is anomalous.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 on both Aug 24 and Aug 25; the 45-day daily average is approximately 17 actions. This could indicate a listing suspension, a data feed outage, or a tracking gap. Check Google Business Profile for any policy flags or listing status issues before 2026-08-28. Success check: GBP actions return to ≥10/day within 3 days of any fix applied.
